# CoolAir AC Service — llms.txt
# Demo site. All contact details, prices, reviews and technician names are mock values.

> CoolAir AC Service is a professional AC repair, installation, cleaning, gas filling and maintenance business serving Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai and Pune (mock demo site). 24/7 emergency service. Prices from ₹299 diagnosis, ₹499 basic service, ₹999 deep cleaning, ₹2,499 gas refill, ₹1,999 split installation. AMC plans from ₹1,499/year.
